def LongestPalindromeSubString(text):
	N = len(text)
	if N <= 1:
		return text
	N = 2 * N + 1
	L = [0] * N
	L[0] = 0
	L[1] = 1
	C = 1
	R = 2
	i = 0
	iMirror = 0
	maxLPSLength = 0
	maxLPSCenterPosition = 0
	start = -1
	end = -1
	diff = -1
	for i in range(2, N):
		iMirror = 2 * C - i
		L[i] = 0
		diff = R - i
		if diff > 0:
			L[i] = min(L[iMirror], diff)
		try:
			while (i + L[i] < N and i - L[i] > 0) and ((i + L[i] + 1) % 2 == 0 or text[(i + L[i] + 1) // 2] == text[(i - L[i] - 1) // 2]):
				L[i] += 1
		except Exception as e:
			pass
		if L[i] > maxLPSLength:
			maxLPSLength = L[i]
			maxLPSCenterPosition = i
		if i + L[i] > R:
			C = i
			R = i + L[i]
	start = (maxLPSCenterPosition - maxLPSLength) // 2
	end = start + maxLPSLength - 1
	if len(text[start:end + 1]) == 1:

	return text[start:end + 1]
